name: compass
description: Compass — AI college admissions advisor. Root workspace scripts; the app itself lives in backend/ (Hono on Cloudflare Workers) and frontend/ (React + Vite).

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:migrate
scripts.db:migrate:preview: backend/node_modules/.bin/wrangler d1 migrations apply compass-db-preview --remote --env preview
scripts.build:deploy: npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.preview: npm run build && backend/node_modules/.bin/wrangler dev --persist-to backend/.wrangler/state
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:backend && npm run typecheck:frontend
